title: Homepage
comment: Homepage's state is its config directory of YAML files (settings.yaml, services.yaml, bookmarks.yaml, widgets.yaml, custom.css/js). The FreeBSD port serves the app from /usr/local/www/homepage with config/ inside it, owned by the web user (WWWOWN www, uid 80 -- the port registers no dedicated user; verify on the box round); the Daemonless image reads the same files from /config, as the upstream ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage image does from /app/config. Docker-integration widgets reference sockets that do not exist on the appliance; they carry as text and the affected widgets show errors until edited.
drop: the built application tree (the image ships its own)
